# SD18 deterministic Human Fighter level 18 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic Human Fighter pilot from the bounded
# level 17 (fourth Weapon Training group) tranche to level 18 as chosen input
# only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity
# values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam and the
# deterministic Longsword / Chain Shirt / no-shield posture. Level 18 IS a
# Fighter bonus-feat cadence level (1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18, ...),
# so this fixture adds a ninth named bonus-feat choice slot
# (choice:fighter_bonus_feat_18, canonically Staggering Critical, whose
# prerequisites -- Critical Focus and base attack bonus +13 -- are honestly
# met by the level-16 Critical Focus bonus feat and the level-18 base attack
# bonus of +18). It is NOT a Weapon Training rank-rise level (rank stays 4,
# an integer-division coincidence with level 17; PF1 names no fifth Weapon
# Training rank in this range) and NOT an Armor Training rank-rise level
# (rank stays 4; Armor Training has no fifth rank in the PF1 Core Rulebook),
# so no new weapon-training-group or armor-training choice is added.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-fighter-level18-sd18-widening
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:fighter:18
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:8
feat=feat:power_attack
feat=feat:dodge
feat=feat:weapon_focus
feat=feat:toughness
feat=feat:cleave
feat=feat:combat_reflexes
feat=feat:improved_critical
feat=feat:greater_weapon_focus
feat=feat:weapon_specialization
feat=feat:greater_weapon_specialization
feat=feat:critical_focus
feat=feat:staggering_critical
skill=skill:climb:1
skill=skill:intimidate:1
skill=skill:swim:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
equipment=power_attack:selected_inactive
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:fighter_bonus_feat:feat:weapon_focus:weapon:longsword
choice=choice:fighter_bonus_feat_2:feat:toughness
